errors.trigger: Arguments are missing, repeated or unsupported.
errors.remediation: Use the exact command help contract.

errors.trigger: A JSON input is not one object.
A value violates its closed schema.
A locator is missing, unsafe or symlink-backed.
errors.remediation: Use a regular file below the repository or package.

errors.trigger: Task, base, candidate or checkpoint identity is no longer current.
errors.remediation: Rebuild the pair from current live Git facts.

errors.trigger: The controlled candidate cannot be created or validated.
errors.remediation: Review objective candidate evidence and select a semantic route.

errors.trigger: A required package runtime dependency is unavailable.
errors.remediation: Install the complete Guru Team preset dependencies.

errors.trigger: An unexpected package-local runtime failure occurred.
errors.remediation: Inspect the package-local runtime and retry.
